kernelsu.notes: Official KernelSU. SUSFS is the gki-android12-5.10 kernel patch plus 10_enable_susfs_for_ksu.patch from the same commit.

kernelsu-next.notes: Always built from pershoot's dev-susfs fork. That branch already carries manager-side KSU_SUSFS, so the official SUSFS patch is not needed (it did not apply to KernelSU-Next's own dev).

sukisu-nova.notes: SUSFS builds check out the builtin branch, which already carries manager-side KSU_SUSFS.

bakasu.notes: Official main already contains manager-side KSU_SUSFS.
